title: I Grew Real Spider Silk Using Yeast
summary: The Thought Emporium shows how they engineered a yeast strain to produce real spider silk, after more than two years of lab work and many failures. The video explains the genetic engineering process behind it.
why: HN commenters cite it as proof that cutting-edge biotech is becoming accessible to home labs, much like computing in the 1980s.

quote.text: advanced cutting-edge biotech is getting to be as accessible as computing was getting in the 80s
